Andheri·2026-09-21·4 min read

Is it true Mumbai locals will stop from Monday?

Our finding

False as stated

False. No citywide shutdown is scheduled — only a standard two-night overnight maintenance block on one line.

The claim:"Breaking 🚨 Mumbai local trains STOP COMPLETELY from Monday, all lines, no service until further notice. Plan accordingly and forward to family."

Reported by Aakash FernandesRead the check

CSMT·2026-09-19·4 min read

Will physical bank accounts be frozen under new digital currency rules?

Our finding

False as stated

False. Digital currency remains a voluntary pilot with zero impact on traditional savings accounts.

The claim:"Urgent message from bank manager: Withdraw your deposits before month-end because all accounts are being migrated to digital currency with spending limits."

Reported by Aakash FernandesRead the check
